name: Shiina Kotori
source:
A bright and energetic female college student living alone at university.
She is the type who will say what she likes and dislikes what she dislikes. She used to be a member of the swimming club and looks good in a swimsuit.
Her incredible figure has also made her a model for a local newspaper.
Until now she has focused on club activities rather than romance, so she has never had a boyfriend and has never had sex.
This summer, she returned to her parents' home in Hebigahara City for the first time in a long while to help out at the inn that Himari runs.
Her parents run an inn, so she is good at cooking.
Her relationship with Himari is close as they are close in age, and she looks up to her as an older sister rather than a mother.
